input.overview: Old Coney Island! builds a persistent Bonus X from either C-O-N-E-Y lanes, the I-S-L-A-N-D-! target bank, or the kickout hole. Reaching 2x lights the spinner for 1,000 per spin, while loop rollovers add bonus and the top loop can advance the kickout multiplier or award Extra Ball. The kickout scores 5,000 through 5x 5,000, then Special or 25,000 when lit.
input.simpleOverview: Complete C-O-N-E-Y lanes or the I-S-L-A-N-D-! target bank to raise Bonus X. At 2x the spinner lights for 1,000 per spin. Shoot loop rollovers to build bonus and the kickout multiplier, then collect the kickout for 5,000 through 25,000 or its lit award.
input.summary: Take C-O-N-E-Y lanes whenever offered: they raise Bonus X, light the spinner at 2x, and eventually qualify Special. Use the loops for bonus and kickout growth, then collect the kickout when its lit value justifies the rejection risk. Most progress survives the drain.

quickInfo.name: Raise Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Complete C-O-N-E-Y, I-S-L-A-N-D-!, or the lit kickout progression.

quickInfo.name: Light Special
quickInfo.summary: After 5x, complete C-O-N-E-Y or the target bank again.

steps.text: Complete C-O-N-E-Y through the top lanes to raise Bonus X and, at 2x, light the spinner for 1,000 per spin.
Shoot the lit spinner and the loop rollovers to add bonus and advance the kickout-hole multiplier.
Complete I-S-L-A-N-D-! when its target return is controlled; that sequence also advances Bonus X.
Shoot the kickout when its 5,000-through-5x value or lit award is worth the risk.

alternatives.title: Loop-and-spinner route
alternatives.when: Use this when the drop targets are rejecting or returning toward the center.

steps.text: Finish C-O-N-E-Y from the top and bring the game to at least 2x.
Repeat the now-lit spinner for 1,000 per spin.
Take the top loop rollover to grow the kickout award and collect the kickout only when safely available.
Alternate C-O-N-E-Y lanes, I-S-L-A-N-D-! targets, and kickout progress to reach 5x.
After 5x is lit, complete either C-O-N-E-Y or the full target bank again to light Special.
Collect the lit Special at its indicated playfield shot, or take the configured point substitute.

machineSetup: Test every C-O-N-E-Y rollover, the full I-S-L-A-N-D-! bank and reset, spinner, both loop rollovers, kickout hole and eject, bumper-light standups, and all Bonus X and award lamps.
Confirm the Extra Ball and Special substitutions and verify that lane, multiplier, kickout, and other feature progress carries between balls while the target bank itself resets as designed.

playfieldReferences.description: Drop-target sequence that raises Bonus X and later lights Special.

playfieldReferences.label: Loop rollovers
playfieldReferences.description: Loop switches that add bonus and advance kickout awards.

playfieldReferences.label: Kickout hole
playfieldReferences.description: Collect shot for growing 5,000 multiples and lit awards.

playfieldReferences.label: Bumper-light standups
playfieldReferences.description: Top and bottom standups that light the nearby bumpers.

cautions.issue: Carryover is broad but not universal.
cautions.response: Treat C-O-N-E-Y, multiplier, and kickout progress as persistent, but expect the I-S-L-A-N-D-! targets themselves to reset and verify award substitutions on the installed game.
